jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Nowshera Digital is seeking an accomplished Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead architecture across our client platforms, modern web APIs, and responsive applications.
requirements: 5+ years building production web applications in TypeScript / Node.js
Strong expertise in modern React and state management architecture
Demonstrated experience with relational and document databases
Solid background in API design, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines

jobs.title: UI/UX Product Designer
jobs.description: Craft intuitive user interfaces, design systems, and delightful workflows for high-growth enterprise web applications.
requirements: 3+ years experience designing web and mobile user experiences in Figma
Deep understanding of typography, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive layouts
Portfolio demonstrating user journeys, design tokens, and rapid prototyping

jobs.title: Backend Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Build scalable distributed backend services, caching layers, and high-performance APIs.
requirements: 3+ years backend development experience with Node.js / Go / Python
Experience building robust microservices and event-driven architectures
Hands-on expertise with cloud deployment, Docker, and caching strategies

jobs.title: QA Automation Lead
jobs.description: Lead automated regression testing and quality frameworks.
requirements: 4+ years in Cypress or Playwright test suites

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Nowshera Digital is looking for an AI Automation Engineer to design and build intelligent automation workflows using AI models, APIs, and workflow automation platforms.
requirements: 1+ year of experience in AI automation or software development
Knowledge of Python
Experience with OpenAI or other LLM APIs
Experience with n8n or similar automation platforms
Understanding of REST APIs and webhooks
Knowledge of JSON
Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL or Supabase
Basic understanding of prompt engineering
Ability to troubleshoot automation workflows
Good problem-solving and communication skills

profileBullets: Over 6 years of full-stack engineering experience specializing in TypeScript and React ecosystems.
Proven record in designing scalable RESTful APIs, microservices, and database schemas.
Strong command of automated testing, containerized deployments, and agile project delivery.
matchedRequirements: 5+ years building production web applications in TypeScript / Node.js
Strong expertise in modern React and state management architecture
Demonstrated experience with relational and document databases
missingRequirements: Specific CI/CD pipeline automation setup not explicitly detailed in CV text
interviewQuestions: How have you architected state management and performance optimizations in large React applications?
Can you describe your strategy for database indexing and schema migrations in production?
What automated testing strategies do you employ to guarantee zero-downtime releases?

recruiterNotes.content: Strong background in modern TypeScript and React. Looks like a solid fit for the Senior Full Stack role.

rawPayload.short_profile:
• Software Engineer with 3 years of experience in full-stack development, specializing in Python and JavaScript.
• Experience in building and deploying web applications using frameworks like Django and React.
• Proficient in cloud technologies, including AWS, and familiar with CI/CD pipelines.
• Demonstrated ability to work in an Agile environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
